慢生活手记

记录日子里的小事：早起、读书、散步，和一杯热茶。

2026 年 11 月 13 日

清晨的街道

天还没全亮的时候，街道是安静的。面包房刚开门，热气从门缝里飘出来，环卫车慢慢开过，洒水留下的痕迹还没干。

早起的好处，是能把一天最安静的一个小时留给自己。走一走，跑一跑，出一点汗，回来冲个澡，整个人都清醒了。

2026 年 11 月 11 日

读一点英文，慢慢来

最近睡前会读一小段英文，不求快，遇到好用的词就记下来，第二天试着在句子里用一次。语言这件事，靠的不是一次学很多，而是每天都碰一碰。

今天记下的一个词是 lively，活泼的、生气勃勃的。形容人、形容一场讨论、形容一个热闹的晚上，都用得上。

2026 年 11 月 8 日

周末的菜市场

周末去了一趟菜市场。摊主们嗓门都大，讨价还价声此起彼伏，反而让人觉得踏实。买了一把青菜、几个番茄，还有刚出锅的烧饼。

日子过得好不好，有时候就看这些小地方：饭吃得香不香，觉睡得沉不沉，路走得稳不稳。

Learning from different generations

向不同世代学习 · BBC Learning English《6 Minute English》· 主持人 Georgie 和 Phil

英格兰 Chester 的一家退休村里开起了托儿所，孩子们称老人为 grand-friends，一起跳舞、做手工、讲故事。研究发现，跨代相处能减少孤独感、改善身心状态，也打破了人们对年龄的刻板印象。下面是按这一主题写的跟读稿，听完可以跟着大声读一遍。

在新页面打开音频 下载到手机 BBC 原文页面
文字稿（重点词已标黄）

Hello, and welcome to tonight's English practice. Today we are talking about something warm and surprising: what happens when the oldest and the youngest people in a town spend their days together?

In Chester, a city in the north-west of England, a nursery has opened inside a retirement village. Every day, small children and older residents share the same library, the same garden, and the same dining room. The children call the older people their grand-friends. Together, they sing, they dance, they make things with paper and paint, and they tell each other stories.

One of the grand-friends is Ian. Ian used to fly fighter planes. After his wife died last year, he felt that something important was missing from his life. There was a big empty space, and he did not know how to fill it. Then the people at the nursery invited him to join them. Now he visits the children often, and he teaches them to make paper planes. He says he loves watching them learn and grow.

The nursery is run by a charity called Ready Generations. The charity works with universities to study how mixing generations affects our health and happiness. The early results are very positive. Studies from around the world have found the same thing: when older and younger people spend time together, both groups feel less lonely. They feel healthier and happier. They also learn faster, and they become more creative.

These projects also break down stereotypes. Many people think young children are noisy and full of energy, while older people are quiet and slow. But in Chester, the staff sometimes have to ask the older residents to calm down, because they are the lively ones! The children are often the quiet ones, listening carefully. Everyone is surprised, and everyone laughs.

So, what can we learn from different generations? Perhaps the answer is simple. Older people have stories, patience, and life experience. Younger people have curiosity, energy, and fresh ideas. When they meet in the middle, both sides grow.

Now it is your turn. Think about your own life. Is there someone much older, or much younger, than you, who has taught you something important? Try to describe that person in English, in two or three sentences. Who are they? What did you learn from them? Take your time, and say it out loud. Good luck, and see you next time.

重点单词（12 个，含近义词举一反三）

1. generation /ˌdʒen.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ 名词
中文
同一代的人；一代人
常用搭配
the younger generation 年轻一代；a generation gap 代沟；generation after generation 一代又一代
例句
People from different generations often see the world in different ways.（不同世代的人看世界的方式常常不一样。）
近义词
age group 只指年龄段，不带文化经历含义；era 指一个时代，范围更大，如 the digital era。
2. fill a void /fɪl ə vɔɪd/ 动词短语
中文
填补（内心的）空虚；弥补缺失
常用搭配
fill the void left by someone 填补某人离开后留下的空缺；fill a void in your life
例句
After his wife died, joining the nursery helped Ian fill a void in his life.（妻子去世后，加入托儿所帮 Ian 填补了生活中的空虚。）
近义词
fill a gap 偏具体的空缺，如时间空档；make up for something 是补偿过失，语气不同。
3. such and such /sʌtʃ ənd sʌtʃ/ 口语短语
中文
某某；这样那样
常用搭配
do such and such 做这样那样的事
例句
They phoned me and said, "We are doing such and such today. Why don't you come and join us?"（他们打电话说今天有这样那样的活动，问我要不要一起。）
近义词
and so on / etc. 用在列举之后表示「等等」；this and that 也指零碎小事，更随意。
4. hear on the grapevine /hɪər ɒn ðə ˈɡreɪp.vaɪn/ 习语
中文
听小道消息；道听途说
常用搭配
hear it on the grapevine；hear through the grapevine
例句
I heard on the grapevine that you teach the children to make paper planes.（我听小道消息说，你在教孩子们做纸飞机。）
近义词
hear a rumour 意思相近但更直接；gossip 作动词指说人闲话，带负面意味。
5. break down stereotypes /breɪk daʊn ˈster.i.ə.taɪps/ 动词短语
中文
打破刻板印象
常用搭配
break down barriers 打破隔阂；challenge a stereotype 质疑刻板印象
例句
Mixing generations helps break down stereotypes about old people being quiet and slow.（跨代相处有助于打破「老人安静迟缓」的刻板印象。）
近义词
challenge stereotypes 只是提出质疑；change people's minds 泛指改变想法，范围更广。
6. lively /ˈlaɪv.li/ 形容词
中文
活泼的；生气勃勃的；热闹的
常用搭配
a lively discussion 热烈的讨论；a lively atmosphere 热闹的气氛
例句
The older people are so lively that the staff sometimes ask them to calm down.（老人们非常活泼，工作人员有时还得请他们冷静一点。）
近义词
energetic 偏体力充沛；noisy 只说吵闹，常带负面意味；vivid 多形容色彩、记忆鲜明，不形容人。
7. loneliness /ˈləʊn.li.nəs/ 名词
中文
孤独；寂寞
常用搭配
feel lonely 感到孤独；reduce loneliness 减少孤独感
例句
Spending time with children can help older people reduce loneliness.（和孩子相处能帮助老人减少孤独感。）
近义词
solitude 指主动享受的独处，偏正面；isolation 强调与外界隔绝的状态，偏客观。
8. wellbeing /ˌwelˈbiː.ɪŋ/ 名词
中文
健康与幸福；身心健康
常用搭配
mental wellbeing 心理健康；improve your wellbeing 改善身心状态
例句
The project improves the wellbeing of both children and older people.（这个项目改善了孩子和老人的身心健康。）
近义词
health 偏身体健康；happiness 只说快乐情绪；welfare 偏社会福利、物质保障。
9. nursery /ˈnɜː.sər.i/ 名词
中文
托儿所；幼儿园（英式）；苗圃
常用搭配
a nursery school 幼儿园；send a child to nursery 送孩子上托儿所
例句
The nursery opened inside a retirement village in Chester.（这家托儿所开在 Chester 的一处退休村里。）
近义词
kindergarten 偏 4–6 岁学前班；daycare 是美式说法，偏日间托育。
10. retirement /rɪˈtaɪə.mənt/ 名词
中文
退休
常用搭配
a retirement village 退休村；retirement age 退休年龄；plan for retirement
例句
The nursery shares a library and a garden with the retirement village.（托儿所与退休村共用图书馆和花园。）
近义词
pension 指退休金（钱），不是状态；resignation 是辞职，不等于退休。
11. bond /bɒnd/ 名词／动词
中文
（情感上的）联系、纽带；建立亲密关系
常用搭配
a close bond 亲密的联系；bond with someone 与某人建立感情；family bonds 家庭纽带
例句
Many children develop a special bond with their grandparents.（许多孩子与祖父母之间有一种特殊的感情。）
近义词
relationship 泛指任何关系；connection 偏泛泛的联系；attachment 偏依恋、依附感。
12. creativity /ˌkriː.eɪˈtɪv.ə.ti/ 名词
中文
创造力
常用搭配
boost creativity 激发创造力；creative thinking 创造性思维
例句
Mixing with different generations can boost children's learning and creativity.（与不同世代相处能促进孩子的学习与创造力。）
近义词
imagination 是想象力，偏脑中画面；innovation 强调把新想法变成实际成果；originality 强调独创性。
